source_title: PM-SYM Scheme Guidelines - Ministry of Labour & Employment
target_beneficiaries: Unorganized workers aged 18 to 40 years earning Rs. 15,000 or less per month

eligibility_criteria.occupation: Unorganized worker (street vendor, agriculture worker, construction worker, head loader, domestic worker, cobbler, auto rickshaw driver, ragpicker, brick kiln worker, beedi worker, etc.)
eligibility_criteria.monthly_income: Monthly income must not exceed Rs. 15,000 per month
exclusions: Any worker covered under organized social security schemes: Employees' Provident Fund Organization (EPFO)
Any worker covered under Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Any subscriber to National Pension System (NPS) contributed by Central Government
Any individual who is an Income Tax payer

benefits.assured_pension: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 upon attaining the age of 60 years
benefits.government_contribution: 50% matching monthly contribution by Central Government (matching worker's monthly contribution between Rs. 55 and Rs. 200 depending on entry age)
benefits.family_pension: If subscriber dies, spouse receives 50% of pension (Rs. 1,500/month) as family pension

online_steps: Visit official portal https://maandhan.in/ and click on 'Enrollment'
Select 'Self Enrollment' and enter 10-digit mobile number for OTP login
Enter Aadhaar Number, Name as per Aadhaar, Date of Birth, Gender, and State
Provide Bank Account details (Account Number, Bank Name, Branch, IFSC Code)
Select monthly contribution auto-debit consent and print auto-debit mandate form
Upload signed auto-debit mandate copy and download PM-SYM Pension Card
application_process.offline_option: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar Card and Savings Bank Passbook/Jan Dhan Account; Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) completes biometric authentication and issues Shram Yogi Pension Card immediately

required_documents: Savings Bank Account Passbook or Jan Dhan Bank Account with IFSC code
